title: Baluchistan Marble and Coal Permit or Rahdari Procedure Rules 1978

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Marble and Coal Permit or Rahdari Procedure Rules 1978
sections.section: RULE - Baluchistan Marble and Coal (Permit or Rahdari Procedure) Rules 1978
sections.description:
BALUCHISTAN MARBLE AND COAL (PERMIT/RAHDARI PROCEDURE) RULES, 1978
BALUCHISTAN MARBLE AND COAL (PERMIT/RAHDARI PROCEDURE) RULES, 1978
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 24th April, 1979]
No. S. O. (MD) 1-20/77.-In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 10 of the Baluchistan Marble and Coal Minerals (Control of Movement)
Ordinance, 1978, the Government of Baluchistan is pleased to make the following
rules;----
1. Short title, extent and commencement. (1) These rules may be
called the Baluchistan Marble and Coal (Permit/Rahdari Procedure) Rules, 1978.
(2) These rules shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.-In these rules, unless the context otherwise
requires, the following expressions shall have the meaning hereby respectively
assigned to them, that is to say;---
(a) "Dealer" means, the person/individual/agency
association carrying on business of selling and purchase of Marble and Coal,
other than a Mining Concessionaire.
(b) "Form" means, the form attached to these rules.
(c) "Mining Goncessionaire" means, the person to whom
concession of licence or lease for marble and coal has been granted under the
Baluchistan Mining Concession Rules, 1970.
3. Information to be provided in Application for the Grant of
Permit/ Rahdari.-(1) Every application for a permit/rahdari to despatch coal or
marble from the Province of Baluchistan to other Provinces shall be made in
Form PR-1.
(2) Any dealer, before making an application for the grant of a
permit/ rahdari shall get himself registered with the Licensing Authority on
the form PR-2. The permit/rabdari shall be issued in Form PR-3 to the
Registered dealers only. The application for Registration should be accompanied
by a challan of Rs. 100 as Registration Fee to be deposited under the Receipted
Head of Account "XLVI-Misc-K-Receipts-Arising out of Mines-Oil Fields and
Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948. The initial period of
Registration shall be one year and removable for like periods.
(3) On receipt of the application for permit/rahdari the Licensing
Authority may, after examining the relevant material produced by the dealer,
issue a permit/rahdari, in Form PR-3 subject to the following conditions :-
(a) The permit/rahdari shall be issued for a period not exceeding
three months fro the date of issue of the permit/rahdari. The permit/rahdari
shall, however be extendable for another period of three months on submission
of application quoting sufficient cause for not removing the mineral within the
specific period.
(b) The despatch/removal of coal and marble shall be completed
within the period specified in the permit/rahdari.
(e) The permit shall be returned to the Licensing Authority on
expiry of the specified period after it is certified by the Mining
Concessionnaire, that the conditions of the permit/rahdari have been duly
satisfied in the prescribed manner.
(d) The application for grant of permit/rahdari may be rejected by
the Licensing Authority without giving any reason therefor.
(e) The Licensing Authority may cancel any such permit/rahdari if
he is satisfied that any of these rules are being infringed by the dealer
concerned.
4. Submission of Monthly Returns.-The dealer shall submit to the
Licensing Authority a monthly return in Form PR-4 regularly so as to reach the
Licensing Authority before 7th of each ensuing month. A `NIL' return has to be
submitted even if there is no despatch in a month.
5. Maintenance of Register.-The Licensing Authority shall keep a
Register in the Form PR-5 wherein the particulars of the registeration of the
dealer may be maintained properly. Record of the accounts of purchase and
disposal shall be maintained in a Register in form PR-4 by the Licensing
Authority.
6. Appeal.-Aggrieved by a decision of the Licensing Authority an
appeal shall lie to the Government within thirty (30) days of the date of the
decision. The decision of the Government shall be final.
[Note-For Forms PR-1 to PR-5 please see Gazette of Baluchistan,
